_comment: Example firmware catalog for firmware_config. Copy to <site>/firmware/catalog.json.
ORDER IS THE CONTRACT. Each component's versions are listed NEWEST FIRST, and
that order is the ONLY source of truth for what firmware_target_mode=latest
resolves to. The role never infers which of two Lenovo version strings is
newer: the formats are inconsistent ('68P-6.20', '26.46.3048', 'E3MQ005') and
lexically '68P-6.9' sorts above '68P-6.20', which would silently downgrade a BMC.
machine_type must match the host's Redfish SKU. A catalog built for another
model is refused rather than applied.
'file' names a payload in firmware_payload_dir. Component ids must match the
BMC's FirmwareInventory ids exactly - note adapters update via 'Slot_N.Bundle',
